scope: The patch geometry, cap tail and actual exterior coverage now share a concrete energetic criterion. With tau=(1/256)^2/2, backgroundCost=2*incidentEnergy+3*endpointEnergy<=tau implies all prior incident-plaquette and endpoint chord hypotheses as well as the cap-tail margin. The actual eligible interior covariance is bounded by B_{a,M}=8*|S|*log(81)/(beta-a)+20*exp(|S|*log C(beta)+2*M-beta*tau), with (a,M)=(1,4) for the two-source law and (2,6) for the additionally transported source. A concrete reset background keeps the sampled field outside S and replaces its active links by the first endpoint u. The global incident-potential second-difference estimate, positivity and the quaternion kinetic triangle inequality prove backgroundCost(reset)<=70*localEnergy(v;u,w), retaining every crossing plaquette. The reset and its exterior dependence are continuous. Ineligible exterior backgrounds therefore satisfy tau<=70*localEnergy on every corresponding sampled field. For any finite measure on that field space and any nonnegative continuous source weight W, their full-field weighted contribution is at most (70/tau)*integral(localEnergy*W) under the same measure. The full sourced middle Gibbs law is proved to push to exactly the existing exterior marginal. Its ineligible-background probability is thus at most (70/tau) times its actual local-energy expectation. Combining the eligible covariance bound, the uniform absolute covariance bound four and the exact spatial disintegration gives full middle covariance <=B_{a,M}+(280/tau)*E_A(localEnergy)+absolute retained exterior-response covariance. Concrete original two-source and extra-source Wilson instances are proved for arbitrary endpoints, with no supplied good-background hypothesis. The energy expectation and retained covariance are actual uncontrolled quantities; the result does not assert they are small. The outer boundary recursion still retains the propagated endpoint-response covariance. No spatial-separation decay, depth-uniform far-sum closure, global lower coercivity or continuum construction is proved. All twelve full Clay requirements remain open.

actual_objects.reset: The sampled middle field is retained outside S; active links are copied from the first endpoint u.
actual_objects.localEnergy: Every incident spatial plaquette defect, including all crossings, plus kineticPart(S,v,u)+kineticPart(S,v,w).
actual_objects.ineligible: The genuine exterior configurations whose reset backgroundCost exceeds tau.
actual_objects.energyMoment: The expectation of localEnergy under the full unrestricted middle Gibbs law with its actual sources.
actual_objects.retainedCovariance: Covariance of the actual conditional means under the genuine exterior marginal.

proved_results: The single energetic criterion backgroundCost<=tau implies every prior patch-curvature hypothesis and the cap-tail margin.
The eligible two-source and extra-source interior laws obey the explicit B_{1,4} and B_{2,6} budgets.
The reset background is continuous and preserves the actual sampled exterior.
The incident-potential upper bound is incident(v)<=2*incident(v0)+32*distanceSq for fields sharing their exterior.
The reset background has cost at most 70 times the same sampled local bridge energy.
For any finite field measure and continuous W>=0, the ineligible weighted contribution is <=(70/tau)*integral(localEnergy*W) under that same measure.
The actual full middle Gibbs law pushes exactly to its existing exterior marginal, including the interior partition.
The actual exterior ineligible probability is <=(70/tau)*energyMoment.
The actual full two-source middle covariance is <=B_{1,4}+(280/tau)*energyMoment+absolute retained exterior-response covariance, for arbitrary endpoints.
The actual additionally sourced middle covariance obeys the analogous B_{2,6} bound, with overlapping extra links allowed.
next_attack: Bound the actual local-energy moment and its matching response-weighted variants using the true stationary/endpoint/propagated laws.
Control retained exterior-response covariance through localized influence or propagator decay, retaining its full marginal partition.
Transport those estimates through the true endpoint message and sourced partition without discarding the retained endpoint-response covariance.
Establish spatial-separation decay sufficient for the dyadic far sum, then prove the independent global lower coercivity on the physical time scale.
Preserve the separate continuum compactness, coupling/time scaling and nonzero reflected-source survival obligations.
not_inferred: All twelve full Clay requirements remain open; no continuum Yang-Mills construction or uniform physical mass gap is proved.
Coverage is quantitatively charged to the actual local-energy moment, not proved uniformly small for arbitrary endpoint inputs or the propagated source hierarchy.
The weighted coverage theorem preserves a nonnegative continuous source weight under the same finite measure. A useful uniform bound on that weighted local-energy moment is still needed.
The full middle covariance bound retains the genuine spatial exterior-response covariance, including its interior partition. It has not been quantitatively controlled.
The exact outer boundary recursion also retains the propagated endpoint-response covariance and its actual message and sourced partition.
The eligible-patch budget and energy error depend on active patch size and do not decay in source separation. The dyadic far-sum premise is still unproved.
The reset construction is a measurable concrete background choice, not a gauge-covariant Balaban block RG or a proof of spatial propagator decay.
Existing stationary averaged slab/bad-bridge energy bounds have not yet been matched to the local-energy term under every required sourced law and response weight.
No global lower coercivity or physical-transfer Poincare inequality, including the center-even sector, follows from these covariance upper bounds.
Controlled coupling/time scaling, a suitable physical overlap margin, reflected compactness and nonzero continuum survival remain open.
